story_type: man alone on a frozen lake, cutter crew walks out on the ice
hook: He tried to walk across a frozen lake.
narration: This man tried to walk across frozen Lake Saint Clair, between Michigan and Ontario.
He was twenty five years old, and he was far out on the ice.
The Coast Guard Cutter Neah Bay, home-ported in Cleveland, came for him.
Neah Bay is an icebreaking tug, built to keep the Great Lakes open in winter.
Her crew climbed down and walked out across the broken ice.
By the time they reached him, he was hypothermic.
They walked him back to the cutter and helped him up the side.
outcome: The Neah Bay crew brought him back to shore in Algonac, Michigan.
title: Tried to walk across a frozen lake
description:
On March 5, 2015, the crew of Coast Guard Cutter Neah Bay rescued a 25-year-old man who was attempting to walk across frozen Lake St. Clair, Michigan, and brought him back to shore in Algonac.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Donald Steffenson, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/393395
